summary.text: Phil M. Hernandez is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 94th District, which covers part of the city of Norfolk, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Hernandez sits on the House committees on Finance; Courts of Justice; Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; and General Laws.

paragraphs.text: Phil M. Hernandez was born in Virginia Beach, Virginia, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Hernandez's education as The College of William and Mary (B.A., in Government and Music, 2010) and UC Berkeley School of Law (JD, 2016).
The profile gives Hernandez's occupation as nonprofit executive.
Hernandez's listed memberships and affiliations include Virginia Bar Association, Virginia League of Conservation Voters (Board Member), Virginia Latino Caucus (Co-Chair).
